<a id="arena2_colours"></a>
### [`arena2_colours`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_screen_e400.asm#L6) `$E400-$E7E7`

*data*

Colour RAM of the arena that is not on screen. The bytes differ from part 2. $8e06 swaps rows 7-22, columns 4-35 with $d800. Nothing reads the other bytes of $e400-$e7ff.
